title: Subarray Sum Equals K
statement:
Given an array of N integers and a target integer K, count the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals exactly K.

A subarray is a contiguous part of the array.

Hint: Use a prefix sum with a hash map to achieve O(N) time.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and K.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the count of subarrays with sum equal to K.
